signals_info.description: Time to collision with the selected lead vehicle; values below 2.5 seconds form the scene's selected danger predicate.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the time to collision shall be greater than or equal to 2.5 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，预计碰撞时间应大于或等于 2.5 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The predicted time to collision shall be at least 2.5 seconds now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 预计碰撞时间应在当前或之后某个时刻达到至少 2.5 秒。
